summary: Opened a follow-up question on the reload path of the inflated StopSign state: the accepted index is an in-memory counter and InternalStorage::load_cache recomputes it from the stored log length plus the marker, so a node that decided the inflated index would restart with accepted 3 against decided 4. Recorded that load-time arithmetic as behavior, added the core load_cache source, and requested one execution of restart_after_covering_sync_cannot_read_decided_log, which builds a node over two entries, the StopSign and decided 4 and checks whether the decided suffix stays readable. Validation is valid with execution_requested true; the local dependency compile for the harness had not finished, so the new test is not yet compile-verified outside the controller's clean run.
